newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n, one week rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n, one week rates rise.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Sunday at the start of the week in the private sector market to between 8-3/4 and nine percent from seven and eight percent, bankers said.
The market is usually short on Sunday after the Friday and Saturday weekend. One banker said there was a lot of demand.
One-week rates also rose to between 8-7/8 and 9-1/4 from 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent on Thursday, the bankers added.
The interbank market has recently become more liquid with the start of the government's new financial year on July 1.
